newsitem.title: UK: Easy availability relaxes European cotton buyers.
newsitem.headline: Easy availability relaxes European cotton buyers.

text.p: Softer New York futures failed to stimulate fresh demand for raw cotton in Europe as easy availability of the most popular growths lulled buyers into a state of relaxation, industry sources said.
Although many spinners are thought to have left significant requirements for nearby shipment uncovered, hand-to-mouth trade buying characterised cotton-buying across Europe.

Several sources reported that a noteworthy volume of Central Asian cotton has arrived at various Italian ports, but it was unclear what proportion was uncommitted and likely to become available to interested buyers. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
